items.text:
Me:
Buy a Derelict
Plan to make it my main ship.
Fill it with expensive parts, to build a reactor.
Tow it closer to OKlG (within 100 km).
The Derelict ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ dissapears whille I am scrapping A DIFFERENT ONE.
Very nice game but you can waste hours and hours of progress because it decided to destroy everything you have been working on for the past 50+ hours.

我：
买一艘废弃飞船
打算把它作为我的主飞船。
用昂贵的部件把它装满，来建造一个反应堆。
把它拖到离OKlG更近的地方（100公里以内）。
那艘废弃飞船♥♥♥♥♥♥♥在我拆解另一艘的时候消失了。
非常好的游戏，但你可以因为游戏决定摧毁你过去50多个小时一直在做的一切而浪费掉一小时又一小时的进度。

items.text:
Good game, riddled with bugs and an awful UI.

Half of my hours have been spent on replaying the same savefiles because of dumb bugs (ship rotating on itself forever/station full of NPCs that kill the framerate/route using more fuel than planned in the setting)

but, hey, this game is only FOUR YEARS OLD, it's ok right? I just had to manually debug it myself following reddit guides.

feels good to spend money in a well polished product

EDIT: hey! just found a new bug! what a happy moment! My 60 days gig disappeared, throwing away my last 2 hours spent in travelling...and the target just casually moved to the other side of the system after loading the save again! F**CK THIS GAME

EDIT 2: nice! now there are only Pirates NPCs in OKLG! the station is now completely useless!
items.text_zh:
好游戏，但满是bug和糟糕的UI。

我一半的游戏时间都花在重玩同样的存档上，因为愚蠢的bug（飞船永远自转/空间站满是NPC导致帧率暴跌/路线在设置中消耗的燃料比计划的多）

但是，嘿，这游戏才只有四年历史，没关系对吧？我只需要按照reddit指南自己手动调试。

花钱买一个精心打磨的产品感觉真好

编辑：嘿！刚发现一个新bug！多么快乐的时刻！我60天的任务消失了，扔掉了我最后2小时花在旅行上的时间……而且加载存档后目标就随便移到了星系的另一边！去他妈的这游戏

编辑2：好极了！现在OKLG里只有海盗NPC了！空间站现在完全没用了！

items.text:
Ce jeu ressemble plus à un GTA 2 horreur SF, dans l'espace qu'à un jeu de construction de vaisseaux. De plus, l'histoire et l'univers dans lequel on évolue est génial et prenant.

Les points faibles du jeu, qui j'espère seront améliorés : 
- la gestion de l'inventaire est compliqué et fait perdre beaucoup de temps,
- les objets au sol peuvent bugger si il y en a trop et disparaître après la relance de la sauvegarde.
- L'Editeur de vaisseaux qu'on nous propose est un enfer, presque inutilisable.
- Pour finir, le jeu n'est pas traduit ce qui un point pour le coup vraiment négatif car il y a beaucoup à lire.
 
Malgré tous ses points négatifs, je pense que ce jeu pourrait être vraiment incroyable; quand il sera fini.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏更像是一款太空背景的科幻恐怖版GTA 2，而不是一款飞船建造游戏。此外，剧情和我们所处的宇宙非常精彩且引人入胜。

游戏的缺点，希望这些能得到改进：
- 物品栏管理很复杂，浪费大量时间，
- 地上的物品如果太多可能会出bug，并在重新加载存档后消失。
- 提供给我们的飞船编辑器简直是地狱，几乎无法使用。
- 最后，游戏没有翻译，这一点确实是非常负面的，因为有很多内容要读。
 
尽管有所有这些负面之处，我认为这款游戏可能会非常惊艳；等它完成的时候。

observations.evidence: les objets au sol peuvent bugger si il y en a trop et disparaître après la relance de la sauvegarde
observations.evidence_zh: 地上的物品如果太多可能会出bug，并在重新加载存档后消失

items.text:
I LOVE THIS GAME
too bad it's half unplayable due to bugs.
Items disappear. Game will freeze. You will need to re-load to get characters to move and behave normally (often). You will lose employees as they disappear under your ship. You will appear in the abyss.

If it weren't for gamebreaking bugs, this would quickly be my favorite game. I've put in enough hours now anyway, just trying, TRYING, to get some milk from this cow. I loved it, but...

DO NOT BUY THIS GAME AS IT IS. 
If you survive long enough, you will delete your save due to bugs.

it makes me so dang sad :(
items.text_zh:
我爱这款游戏
可惜由于bug，它有一半没法玩。
物品会消失。游戏会卡死。你将需要重新加载才能让角色移动并正常行动（经常如此）。你会失去员工，因为他们消失在你船下。你会出现在深渊中。

如果不是因为那些破坏游戏的bug，这会很快成为我最喜欢的游戏。反正我现在已经投入了足够多的时间，只是试着、试着从这头牛身上挤出一点奶。我爱它，但是……

不要按现状购买这款游戏。
如果你活得够久，你会因为bug而删除你的存档。

这让我难过死了 :(

items.text:
Written after calming down this time...

The game has potential. It's unpolished and liable to frustrate you to the point of quitting with or without bugs, though game-breaking bugs are kind of a save killer. The music is great, fun to listen to while watching your crew working. Most challenges can be overcome with time and patience, and most deaths feel like it is your own fault. 

However, there are definitely a few things that need to be fixed before I can recommend this to anyone but the most patient gamers, and they are not minor issues. 

First and foremost, the authority ships. I don't dislike the idea of authority ships chasing you to fine you or arrest you. That's a wonderful mechanic idea. The issue is how often they just flat out crash into you and ruin most of your ship. It's been a recurring enough issue to cause dozens of reloads and a few new games.

Second, the crew. Once again, I love the concept. However...unless I am just making mistakes, then it is nearly impossible to even keep a single crew member with you for any length of time. I don't mean they leave after one mission. I mean they leave the ship, saying they quit and don't want to join anymore immediately after joining.

Next is...I suppose either a glitch or some kind of issue that I'm not aware of. I spent hours (real time) retrofitting a ship that I found to make into my new ship, and it was going well. Time consuming, but well. Last night, I looked over the entire ship and found nothing wrong. Power working throughout the ship, new additions added on and most of my ship equipment now in the new ship. I save, go to bed, and get back on first thing in the morning. The ship somehow has four broken wall tiles that are now letting out all the heat and oxygen that took me hours to get stable. 

Beyond that, I hope to see improvements to this. I am glad that this is early access, because it shows. Rough, unpolished (so far), but with potential. However, I can not recommend this AS OF NOW. This could easily become a thumbs up with a few bug fixes, tweaks, and additional content. What that content would be, I can take a few guesses and have a few hopes.

6/10 for the end result. 9/10 for the concept. 10/10 for music and writing, even with a few very minor typos in select scenes.
items.text_zh:
这次冷静下来后写的……

这游戏有潜力。它未经打磨，无论有没有bug都可能让你沮丧到想退出，不过那些破坏游戏的bug算是存档杀手。音乐很棒，看着你的船员工作时听很享受。大多数挑战都能靠时间和耐心克服，大多数死亡感觉都是你自己的错。

然而，在我能向除了最有耐心的玩家之外的任何人推荐这款游戏之前，肯定有几件事需要修复，而且它们不是小问题。

首先也是最重要的，是权威飞船。我并不讨厌权威飞船追着你罚款或逮捕你的想法。那是个绝妙的机制点子。问题在于它们经常直接撞上你，毁掉你大部分飞船。这已经是个反复出现的问题，导致了几十次读档和几次重开新游戏。

第二，船员。再一次，我喜欢这个概念。然而……除非我只是在犯错，否则几乎不可能让哪怕一个船员在你身边待上任何一段时间。我不是说他们执行一次任务后就离开。我是说他们离开飞船，说他们不干了，而且刚加入就立刻不想再加入了。

接下来是……我想要么是个故障，要么是某种我不知道的问题。我花了几个小时（现实时间）改装一艘我找到的飞船，想把它变成我的新飞船，进展顺利。很耗时，但顺利。昨晚，我检查了整艘飞船，没发现任何问题。电力在全船正常工作，新添加的部分加上了，我的大部分飞船设备现在都在新飞船里。我保存，去睡觉，早上一起来就重新上线。飞船不知怎么有了四块破损的墙板，现在正把花了我几个小时才稳定下来的热量和氧气全都漏出去。

除此之外，我希望看到这方面的改进。我很高兴这是抢先体验，因为这一点很明显。粗糙、未经打磨（到目前为止），但有潜力。然而，就目前而言，我不能推荐这款游戏。只要修几个bug、做些调整并增加额外内容，这很容易就能变成好评。至于那内容会是什么，我可以猜几个，也有几个希望。

最终结果6/10。概念9/10。音乐和文本10/10，即使某些场景里有几个非常小的错别字。

observations.evidence: The ship somehow has four broken wall tiles that are now letting out all the heat and oxygen that took me hours to get stable.

items.text:
At this time I would not recommend it.

Reason is simple, its an early beta... There are so many gamebreaking bugs that makes the game unplayable. Bugs like suddenly the floor becomes unwalkable (in your own ship). Suddenly incapable of sleeping, suddenly the npc station has a hull breach because walls are not walls anymore.

Yes... There are a lot of bugs... The concept is great, but it is not nearly at the stage of being playable.
items.text_zh:
目前我不推荐它。

原因很简单，它还是个早期测试版……有太多破坏游戏的bug，让游戏无法游玩。比如地板突然变得无法行走（在你自己的飞船里）。突然无法睡觉，空间站突然出现船体破裂，因为墙壁不再是墙壁了。

是的……有很多bug……概念很棒，但还远未达到可玩的阶段。

items.text:
Edit:  I first reviewed this game on September 14, 2020, and it was unplayable back then.  It's been almost four years and they've come a long way.

There's a steep learning curve and the only documentation out there is on their discord server, but the game itself is addictive once you get the hang of it.  It scratches a similar itch to House Flipper, but it's spaceships.
items.text_zh:
编辑：我最初是在2020年9月14日评测这款游戏的，当时它根本没法玩。快四年过去了，他们已经进步了很多。

学习曲线很陡峭，而且现有的唯一文档都在他们的Discord服务器上，但一旦你上手，游戏本身就令人上瘾。它满足了一种类似《房产达人》的痒点，只不过对象是宇宙飞船。

observations.change_evidence: It's been almost four years and they've come a long way.
observations.change_evidence_zh: 已经快四年了，他们取得了很大的进步。

items.text:
A true Early Access. Seems cool...but I've personally had some major bugs within first hour....I deleted a save game and now when I try to play a new game, my character wont move. Some annoying GUI....overlays not closing etc...

If your looking for something finished..just wait. If you dont mind testing god knows what bugs....then its worth $10-$15

Ill update to thumbs up once it becomes playable for me a bit.
items.text_zh:
真正的抢先体验。看起来挺酷……但我个人在第一个小时内就遇到了一些重大bug……我删除了一个存档，现在当我尝试开始新游戏时，我的角色无法移动。还有一些烦人的GUI……覆盖层无法关闭等等……

如果你在寻找一款完成度高的作品……那就再等等。如果你不介意测试天知道什么bug……那它值10到15美元。

等它对我来说稍微能玩之后，我会改成好评。

observations.evidence: I deleted a save game and now when I try to play a new game, my character wont move.
